theorem N01Properties.actual_returnResidual_fixedBase_oneHigh
    {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
    {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {R : ReturnEquationData S}
    {base loss : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hN : N01Properties D T S C base loss ε)
    (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S) (hT : IsMaterialData D T)
    (hR : N02Properties D T S C R base ε)
    (hflow : ∀ u ∈ sectorNeighborhood S base ε ε, ∀ m r,
      r ∈ Icc (C.left m) (C.right m) → ∀ θ,
        1 / 2 ≤ deriv (C.minusFlow (liftSectorParameter S C u) m r) θ ∧
        deriv (C.minusFlow (liftSectorParameter S C u) m r) θ ≤ 3 / 2) :
    ∃ B : ℕ, base ≤ B ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ delta : ℕ,
      ∀ R0 : ℝ, 0 ≤ R0 → ∀ s : ℕ, ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧
      ∀ J : SmoothDirections (sectorNeighborhood S base ε ε)
        (fun u => R.residual (liftSectorParameter S C u)),
      ∀ u ∈ sectorNeighborhood S base ε ε,
        pairGrading (sectorGrading S) realGrading B u ≤ R0 →
      ∀ v : Fin k → StateDirections S × ℝ,
        (S.circle (3 / 4 : ℝ)).grading s (J.D k u v) ≤
          K * tameJetSize (pairGrading (sectorGrading S) realGrading) k s delta B u v

decoded_gain.exact_public_header:
theorem circleModel_iteratedDeriv_abs_le
    {T : MaterialData} {γ : ℝ} {S : CircleModelData}
    (hS : IsCircleModel T γ S) (hH : ∀ m, 0 < T.H (T.sample m))
    (u : S.Space) (m b : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :
    |iteratedDeriv b (S.decode u m) θ| ≤
      (2 * circleSobolevConstant * S.grading (b + 1) u) * T.H (T.sample m) ^ γ
decoded_gain.positivity_supplier: (material_circle_sample_weights_pos hT hN.1.1).2, as actually used in ReturnResidualWeightedBounds d8b1b640
decoded_gain.application: Apply circleModel_iteratedDeriv_abs_le hH hHpositive (J.D k x v) m b theta. For b<=s, grading monotonicity bounds grading(b+1) by grading(s+1). Use the strong residual estimate at s+1.
decoded_gain.precise_output: |iteratedDeriv b (H.decode (J.D k x v) m) theta| <= K'(k,R,s) * T.H(T.sample m)^(3/4) * tameJetSize p k s (dR(k)+1) B2 x v, for every b<=s,m,theta.
decoded_gain.constant: K'=2*circleSobolevConstant*K(k,R,s+1); circleSobolevConstant_nonneg is public in the same source.
decoded_gain.no_material_weight_loss: The H exponent remains exactly3/4. No local pointwise evaluation constant depends on m or theta.
decoded_gain.sample_boundary: The circle sample is T.sample m. It is not automatically T.sample(C.cell m) or T.sample(j m). The separate retained primitive/actual-cell comparison in 2dd998.sample_alignment_now_concrete is still required before inserting this into153's closed-buffer host estimates.

theorem N01Properties.endpointFlowCircle_fixedBase_oneHigh
    {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
    {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {base loss : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hN : N01Properties D T S C base loss ε)
    (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S) (hT : IsMaterialData D T) :
    ∃ B : ℕ, base ≤ B ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ L : ℕ, ∀ R : ℝ, 0 ≤ R →
      ∀ s : ℕ, ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧
      ∀ (rsel : ℕ → ℝ) (hrsel : ∀ m, rsel m ∈ Icc (C.left m) (C.right m)),
      ∀ J : SmoothDirections (sectorNeighborhood S base ε ε)
        (hN.endpointFlowCircle hS hT rsel hrsel),
      ∀ x ∈ sectorNeighborhood S base ε ε,
      pairGrading (sectorGrading S) realGrading B x ≤ R →
      ∀ v : Fin n → (StateDirections S × ℝ),
        (S.circle (3 / 4 : ℝ)).grading s (J.D n x v) ≤
          K * tameJetSize (pairGrading (sectorGrading S) realGrading) n s L B x v
public_headers.inverse:
theorem circlePositiveInverseComposeLinear_fixedBase_oneHigh
    (JF : SmoothDirections univ (fun z : M.Space × M.Space =>
      circleShiftedChartComposeContinuousLinear hM hT hD hγ (fun _ => 0) z.1 z.2))
    (JP₀ : SmoothDirections (circlePositiveLiftDomain M ×ˢ univ)
      (fun z : M.Space × M.Space =>
        circlePositiveInverseComposeLinear hM hT hD hγ (fun _ => 0) z.1 z.2))
    (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    ∃ base : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ loss : ℕ, ∀ R : ℝ, 1 ≤ R →
      ∀ s : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (travel : ℕ → ℝ)
        (JP : SmoothDirections (circlePositiveLiftDomain M ×ˢ univ)
          (fun z : M.Space × M.Space =>
            circlePositiveInverseComposeLinear hM hT hD hγ travel z.1 z.2)),
        ∀ x : M.Space × M.Space,
          (∀ m θ, a ≤ deriv (circleAffineLift travel (M.decode x.1) 1 m) θ) →
          pairGrading M.grading M.grading base x ≤ R → ∀ v : Fin n → M.Space × M.Space,
            M.grading s (JP.D n x v) ≤
              C * tameJetSize (pairGrading M.grading M.grading) n s loss base x v
public_headers.composition:
theorem projectiveCompositionJets_fixedBase_oneHigh
    {I E F G : Type*}
    [TopologicalSpace E] [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    [TopologicalSpace F] [AddCommGroup F] [Module ℝ F]
    [TopologicalSpace G] [AddCommGroup G] [Module ℝ G] [IsTopologicalAddGroup G]
    (p : ℕ → Seminorm ℝ E) (q : ℕ → Seminorm ℝ F) (r : ℕ → Seminorm ℝ G)
    (hp : Monotone p) (hI : HasInterpolation (pairGrading realGrading p))
    {U : Set E} {V : Set F} {f : I → E → F} {g : I → F → G}
    (J : ∀ i, SmoothDirections U (f i)) (K : ∀ i, SmoothDirections V (g i))
    (BJ BK : ℕ) (d e : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hJ : ∀ n R, 0 ≤ R → ∀ s, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
      ∀ i x, x ∈ U → p BJ x ≤ R → ∀ v : Fin n → E,
        q s ((J i).D n x v) ≤ C * tameJetSize p n s (d n) BJ x v)
    (hK : ∀ n R, 0 ≤ R → ∀ s, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
      ∀ i y, y ∈ V → q BK y ≤ R → ∀ v : Fin n → F,
        r s ((K i).D n y v) ≤ C * tameJetSize q n s (e n) BK y v)
    (hmap : ∀ i, MapsTo (f i) U V) :
    ∃ B : ℕ, BJ ≤ B ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ L : ℕ, ∀ R : ℝ, 0 ≤ R →
      ∀ s : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ i x, x ∈ U → p B x ≤ R →
      ∀ v : Fin n → E,
        r s (projectiveCompositionJets (f i) (J i).D (K i).D n x v) ≤
          C * tameJetSize p n s L B x v

public_headers.actual_decode:
theorem N01Properties.sectorReturnResidualCircle_decode
    (hN : N01Properties D T S C base loss ε)
    (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S) (hT : IsMaterialData D T)
    (z : StateDirections S × ℝ) (hz : z ∈ sectorNeighborhood S base ε ε)
    (m : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :
    (S.circle (3 / 4 : ℝ)).decode (hN.sectorReturnResidualCircle hS hT z) m θ =
      returnResidualField S C (liftSectorParameter S C z) m θ
